rapport_notes: Calm and professional tone, but minimal warmth or personality; mostly transactional and procedural.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no major process violations detected.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: None — rep launches directly into probing: 'what is your email address?' then jumps to logistics without a framing trade.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep probes 'do you need any help packing boxes or anything like that?' and later 'do you have anything you're particularly concerned about or any items that are like antiques or pianos' — but never the agenda line about biggest concerns beyond price.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — item #3 rule applies: customer did raise a concern (packing availability, box count) but rep acknowledged and moved to logistics; however, since #2 was never asked, there is no valid follow-up gap to score against. Full credit by exception.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep mentions '15 minute increments' and 'minimum,' and gives a specific arrival window '8:30 AM to 9:00 AM arrival window with two guys' — but does not anchor with a typical range for a 1600 sqft move or explicitly personalize beyond the crew size already known.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Calvin: 'ultimately, you only pay for the time that's used over our minimum'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Calvin: 'Yeah, we bill in fifteen minute increments so ultimately, you only pay for the time that's used over our minimum' and later references to letting them know what packing might be done 'cause you can kind of affect the time and then the overall quote quite a bit.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_missing: No 'commit to the rate' (100k moves experience framing). No 'does that feel fair?' asked with silence held. No self-prep tip about items prepped saving time/money. No Meet Your Mover or damage-coverage framing at all. No On-Time Guarantee or Communication (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) mentioned anywhere.

top_strength: Successfully identified this as a pre-scheduled, estimate-already-sent scenario and moved directly to confirmation and availability confirmation — avoiding redundant re-quoting and respecting the customer's time.
coaching_note: This call should have begun with the agenda question ('other than price, what are your biggest concerns?') before jumping to logistics, and lacked any of the Einstein differentiators (damage coverage, On-Time Guarantee, Communication, Meet Your Mover) that should anchor trust — even on a brief confirmation call, one or two should have surfaced organically.
